title: Do the emotion vectors steer emotion
question: When a vector is added during an ordinary answer, does the tone change to that emotion while the text stays fluent?
headline: At layer 12 and strength 1.0, an unsteered reader names the injected emotion 32.9% of the time (chance 5%).
